about: One entry per file in cloudflare/migrations. sha256 freezes the bytes (migrations are append-only); class says what the file may do to a database that is not the client it was written for. Rules: docs/setup/migrations-multi-client.md. Checked by cloudflare/scripts/test-migration-client-neutral-pure.cjs.

classes.SCHEMA: DDL only (tables, indexes, triggers, views, FTS, guard selects). No INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or REPLACE.
classes.GENERIC-DATA: Writes rows by a rule that is correct on any database: backfills of derived columns from the table itself, table rebuilds that copy rows, schema-invariant reconciliations, defaults inserted only if absent. A no-op or correct on an empty database and on another client's populated one.
classes.CLIENT-SPECIFIC-DATA: Carries one client's rows, ids, names or owner policy, or rewrites a populated database by a decision only that client made. Legacy only: never allowed from 0270 on.
